resources.string: Spots incoming calls from your VIPs in WhatsApp, Signal, Telegram and other calling apps, so they ring through silent mode. It only receives those apps\' notifications; it can\'t read your screen or see what you type.

Like Hyper VIP call watcher, and also reads the caller\'s name from the calling app\'s full-screen call screen on a locked phone, and lets a volume button press silence a VIP ring. Only use one of the two. Some banking apps refuse to open while this one is on.
